script: Alright, let’s break down Fortnite’s three core modes. First up, Battle Royale – 100 players parachute onto a shrinking island, loot weapons, and fight to be the last one standing. It’s fast‑paced, solo or in squads, and the storm forces you to keep moving. Next, Save the World – a co‑op PvE campaign where you and up to three friends build forts, gather resources, and fend off waves of husks while completing story missions. Finally, Creative – a sandbox playground that lets you design your own islands, set up custom games, or just experiment with building mechanics. Each mode shares the same bright art style but offers a very different experience. Which mode sounds most exciting to you?
